parent_evidence.btc: DISCOVERY_FAIL_NO_PROMOTION with positive mean/PF but bootstrap lower <=0
parent_evidence.eth: DISCOVERY_FAIL_NO_PROMOTION with positive mean/PF but bootstrap lower <=0 and poor year stability
parent_evidence.rule: BTC and ETH outcomes cannot be used to change any replication rule below.

exact_rule_carryover.direction: contrarian to funding tail when OI growth is high

source_gate.full: per asset: >=35 FULL common months, >=11 FULL months in each 2022/2023/2024; FULL month requires >=95% daily metrics coverage + monthly funding + monthly 1h klines
source_gate.limited: per asset: >=30 USABLE common months, >=8 USABLE months in each year; USABLE month requires >=80% daily metrics coverage

family_adjudication.REPLICATION_STRONG: Both SOLUSDT and BNBUSDT individually pass every frozen gate.
family_adjudication.REPLICATION_PARTIAL: Exactly one asset individually passes every frozen gate AND the other asset has mean net10 > 0, PF net10 > 1, mean net20 > 0 and PF net20 > 1.
family_adjudication.note: REPLICATION_PARTIAL is diagnostic only and is not promotion.

no_rescue: Do not add/remove assets after outcomes.
Do not change thresholds, horizon, sign, costs, rolling windows or overlap rule.
Do not pool BTC/ETH with new assets to manufacture significance.
Do not promote from a partial replication.
